question: What does this corpus text describe, what is the operational core, and which modern chemistry operation does it correspond to?
intended_endpoint: The product of the operation (e.g. Sophick Mercury, Elixir, projected gold).
witnesses: Primary source: title, edition, location, location in corpus
Secondary witness (e.g. contemporary prose source for verse text)

passages.edition: Edition used; year and publisher; PDF file path
passages.transcription: Verbatim text in original spelling; use triple-quoted strings to avoid escape issues
passages.translation: as transcription (or modern English translation if text is non-English)
passages.context: What this passage is doing in the text — narrative, prescription, allegory, comparison, etc.
passages.statement_type: allegory | prescription | comparison | deprecation | theory | etc.
passages.interpretation: Modern chemistry reading; what the operation is; what it produces

materials_as_written: Material 1 as named in the corpus (e.g. Diana = silver)
Material 2 as named in the corpus

identity_hypotheses.label: Modern chemistry identification (e.g. silver chloride, AgCl, white curdy precipitate)
identity_hypotheses.summary: How the operation is performed in modern chemistry; what the inputs and outputs are
identity_hypotheses.support: Why this identification is consistent with the corpus text
identity_hypotheses.counter: Why this identification might be wrong

ordered_operations: Step 1: what the operator does first
apparatus_conditions: Vessel type and material (e.g. round glass flask, iron alembic)
Sealing method (e.g. luted joint, ground glass)
quantities_units_repetitions: Quantity 2: time per cycle (e.g. half a day per Eagle)
intermediates_and_stop_criteria: Stop criterion: how the operator knows the step is complete
claimed_product_and_tests: Product: what the text claims the operation produces
Test 1: visual test the operator applies
Test 2: functional test (e.g. application to base metal)
missing_critical_information: What the corpus does NOT say that the operator would need to know
Quantities not given; timings not given; specific minerals not named
constraint_comparison: C1 (constraint): verdict on consistency with the corpus text
C2 (constraint): verdict on consistency with the corpus text
counterevidence: Evidence against the proposed identification (e.g. pseudo-Bacon attribution, internally-inconsistent projection ratio, OCR-only confirmation)
textual_status: complete on R##-P## (verified passages) | partial (some passages OCR-only) | etc.
identity_status: H1 (most-likely identification) is consistent with...; H2 is less consistent; H3 is weakened by...
efficacy_status: unestablished for transmutation (per OPUS section 13) | established for the operational cycle | etc.
next_discriminating_check: How to discriminate between H1, H2, H3 by modern reproduction or textual comparison
